name: Review requests
description: Asks happy customers for a review after a completed job.
instructions: After a job is completed, and only if the customer sounds satisfied, warmly invite them to leave a quick review and mention it genuinely helps a small local business. Keep it to one short, no-pressure ask, thank them either way, and never chase a customer who declines or seems unhappy — flag_for_human instead so the team can follow up personally.
